C-STABILIZE-PROFILE-ISOLATION.Name: Isolate cache and durable state by the configured application identifier
C-STABILIZE-PROFILE-ISOLATION.Summary: Bind path helpers to the compiled Tauri configuration identifier before rollback and startup consumers, so a separately identified acceptance build cannot share release preferences or durable application data.
C-STABILIZE-PROFILE-ISOLATION.ApprovalBasis: Owner-approved stabilization recovery on 2026-11-09 delegates recommended implementation choices and requires one attributable, isolated acceptance build.

Goals.Goal: Use the configured identifier for cache and data roots on macOS, Linux and Windows.
Keep canonical release paths unchanged and preserve headless rollback namespace consistency.

Constraints.Constraint: CLI help and version exit without profile access; bind the identifier before pre-boot rollback, reconciliation or panic-path consumers.
Do not change HOME or migrate, read, clean or write the owner's existing profile.
Keep path calculation pure and testable using synthetic environment lookups.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No release identifier/version change, profile migration, credential-store policy change or installed-app replacement.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Different valid configured identifiers produce disjoint cache/data roots; the release identifier produces byte-identical existing paths.
Initialization rejects malformed identifiers rather than falling back into the release namespace.
The configured Context used for namespace selection is the same Context passed to Tauri build, and selection precedes rollback paths.
Pure path tests and full Rust compilation pass; the acceptance build records its identifier and profile roots before launch.

VerificationIntent.Command: mkdir -p target && rustc --test src-tauri/src/mt_paths.rs -o target/mt-paths-tests && target/mt-paths-tests
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Synthetic path tests on the reference host, platform CI for other OS branches, compilation of startup wiring and explicit configured acceptance-build namespace.

D-STAB-PROFILE-01.Choice: Initialize an immutable process namespace from the generated Tauri Context before pre-boot state access; keep the release constant as the default for pure/non-app callers.
D-STAB-PROFILE-01.Reason: Path helpers currently hardcode the release identifier; changing the bundle name alone leaves test and release state shared. Runtime configuration binds overrides without duplicating build-script config parsing.

C-STABILIZE-PROFILE-ISOLATION.ExecutionEvidence: 2026-11-09: the namespace-collision regression failed against the former hardcoded joins, then seven pure path/validation tests passed. Full offline Rust cargo check --bin mark passed with no errors. Selected final assertions passed. The acceptance application has not been launched; its configured identifier and profile roots must be recorded with the final artifact. No existing owner profile was migrated or modified.
